chunks: 1621 - Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated from him:
Regarding a man who is given zakat to distribute: is it permissible for him to take some of it from the town in which he is to another? He said: “There is no issue.”

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat, the obligatory alms being distributed
key_terms.الْبَلْدَةِ: the town or locality where the distributor is present
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; it is permissible
key_terms.يَقْسِمُهَا: he distributes it among those entitled

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to transfer zakat from one town to another for distribution?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person entrusted with distributing zakat. It indicates that transferring a portion of the zakat from one town to another is permissible, as the Imam عليه السلام said, “There is no issue.”

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1621 - Hisham ibn al-Hakam, may Allah (swt) have mercy on him, narrated from him (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as))

regarding a man who is given Zakat to distribute: "Is it permissible for him to take a portion of it from the town where he resides to another?"
Imam (as) replied: "There is no issue."
